description: Full production signal template library for Research OS V3. Each template defines the structural contract for a class of signals. SignalGenerator uses these templates to generate candidates.

template_families.description: Volatility compression followed by directional expansion break

thesis_template.what_edge_it_targets: Volatility compression (squeeze) followed by sharp directional expansion
thesis_template.entry_logic: Previous bar had BollingerWidth below squeeze threshold; current bar closes beyond upper or lower band with above-average volume
thesis_template.failure_mode: False break in range or illiquid conditions — price re-enters band immediately
thesis_template.ideal_regime: Pre-breakout: range_chop or transition; Post-trigger: uptrend or downtrend

confirmation_logic_guidelines: Check that RelativeVolume is significantly above 1.0 to ensure participation
Confirm that order flow imbalance is in the direction of the breakout
invalidation_logic_guidelines: Invalidate if the price closes back inside the Bollinger Bands mid-channel
Invalidate if bid/ask spread expands beyond limits during the breakout
signal_quality_notes: Highly sensitive to low-liquidity spikes. Always check spread.
Breakouts without volume support have a 70% failure rate.
template_families.expected_trade_shape: Sharp expansion impulse followed by high-volume consolidation
false_positive_patterns: Stop-runs near key levels that immediately reverse
Intrabar spikes during rollover hours with wide spreads
exit_hints: Exit if BollingerWidth begins to contract again after breakout
Trailing stop below the breakout bar low

template_families.description: Breakout with explicit volume surge confirmation — higher conviction than basic

thesis_template.what_edge_it_targets: Breakout backed by significant participation surge (smart money entry)
thesis_template.entry_logic: BollingerWidth was squeezed, current bar breaks band AND rel_volume >= 2.0
thesis_template.failure_mode: Volume spike from stop-run with no directional follow-through
thesis_template.ideal_regime: uptrend or downtrend with increasing volume

confirmation_logic_guidelines: Confirm that large trade ratio is above 15% (institutional presence)
Ensure the direction matches the overall daily trend bias
invalidation_logic_guidelines: Invalidate if price closes back inside the opposite band within 2 bars
Invalidate if relative volume drops below average on the next bar
signal_quality_notes: Very high conviction. False positives are rare but costly.
Ensure the volume surge is not an isolated block trade.
template_families.expected_trade_shape: Long-bodied trend bars with rising volume and clean follow-through
false_positive_patterns: Wash trading or order book manipulation spikes
Macro news spikes that mean-revert instantly
exit_hints: Exit on volume exhaustion sign
Exit if price crosses the 20 SMA line

template_families.description: Extreme z-score displacement with probability of re-centering

thesis_template.what_edge_it_targets: Statistical overextension from mean — price expected to revert
thesis_template.failure_mode: Trend continuation — entering against a strong persistent trend disguised as reversion

confirmation_logic_guidelines: RSI should confirm extreme overbought/oversold levels
Flow imbalance should start returning to neutral
invalidation_logic_guidelines: Invalidate if a strong trend develops (ema_spread expands)
Invalidate if the price moves further out of bounds (zscore continues expanding)
signal_quality_notes: Do not trade during high-volatility regime. Reversion fails in trends.
Look for divergence signs to improve win-rate.
template_families.expected_trade_shape: V-shaped reversal with quick re-centering to SMA20
false_positive_patterns: Strong breakout continuation looking like overextension
Cascading liquidations driving price down continuously
exit_hints: Exit near the SMA20 line (mean)
Time stop after 8 bars if reversion hasn't occurred

template_families.description: Bollinger Band touch/pierce reversion — price at extreme band

thesis_template.what_edge_it_targets: Price at Bollinger extreme with RSI confirmation and flow exhaustion
thesis_template.entry_logic: bb_pct_b <= 0.05 (near lower band) AND rsi_14 <= 35 AND trade_flow_imbalance_20 > -0.3 (selling exhausting)
thesis_template.failure_mode: Band walking — strong trend causes price to hug band

confirmation_logic_guidelines: Flow imbalance should cross back to positive for longs
Volatility ratio should be low (no momentum breakout)
invalidation_logic_guidelines: Invalidate if price walks the band (bb_pct_b remains close to 0 or 1)
Invalidate if ATR expands rapidly during entry
signal_quality_notes: Band walking is the biggest risk. Tight stop is mandatory.
Check for support/resistance levels.
template_families.expected_trade_shape: Sharp reversal wick rejecting the band edge
false_positive_patterns: News-driven trend expansion hugging the band
Low-volume creep where price slowly moves against you
exit_hints: Exit when price reaches the opposite band
Exit if RSI crosses back to 50

template_families.description: MACD momentum alignment with directional confirmation

thesis_template.what_edge_it_targets: Persistent directional move with momentum confirmation — riding the trend
thesis_template.entry_logic: MACD > MACD_signal AND MACD > 0 AND ema_spread_8_21 > 0 for long; reverse for short
thesis_template.failure_mode: Late entry after trend exhaustion — MACD lagging divergence
thesis_template.ideal_regime: uptrend (long) or downtrend (short) with increasing MACD_hist

confirmation_logic_guidelines: Confirm that MACD histogram is expanding in trend direction
Confirm that volume is rising to validate the move
invalidation_logic_guidelines: Invalidate if MACD crosses back over the signal line
Invalidate if price falls below the SMA20 line
signal_quality_notes: Rely on trend stability metrics. Avoid late trends.
Works best when entering near the beginning of a regime transition.
template_families.expected_trade_shape: Steady stair-stepping price path with shallow pullbacks
false_positive_patterns: Sideways consolidation showing MACD crosses without trend
V-shaped spikes that revert instantly
exit_hints: Exit on MACD histogram sign reversal
Exit on crossing the EMA21 line

template_families.description: Trend continuation after shallow pullback to EMA

thesis_template.what_edge_it_targets: Higher-probability re-entry after pullback to support in established trend
thesis_template.entry_logic: price_vs_sma20 within -0.01 to +0.01 (touching SMA) AND ema_spread_8_21 > 0 (uptrend intact) AND rsi bounced from 40-50 zone

confirmation_logic_guidelines: Confirm that order flow imbalance returns to positive (buying support)
Confirm that price rejects the SMA20 with a rejection tail
invalidation_logic_guidelines: Invalidate if price breaks and closes below the SMA20 by more than 1%
Invalidate if ema_spread turns negative (trend shift)
signal_quality_notes: Pullback should occur on lower volume. Volume expansion on pullback indicates breakdown.
Verify regime support.
template_families.expected_trade_shape: Orderly pullback to SMA20 followed by sharp acceleration in trend direction
false_positive_patterns: Head-and-shoulders patterns building at the top
Deep pullbacks that break structure and go sideways
exit_hints: Exit near the previous swing high
Trailing stop below the pullback low pivot

template_families.description: Detect rapid change in micro-volatility or liquidity state

thesis_template.what_edge_it_targets: Microstructure instability preceding larger directional move
thesis_template.entry_logic: micro_volatility_20 spike AND spread_bps within normal range (liquidity still present)
thesis_template.failure_mode: Noise spikes with no follow-through — volatility event without directional resolve
thesis_template.ideal_regime: transition_ambiguous — early detection before regime flip

confirmation_logic_guidelines: Check that relative volume confirms the presence of liquidity
Ensure volatility expansion ratio is high
invalidation_logic_guidelines: Invalidate if the volatility spike collapses back to average immediately
Invalidate if spread expands too wide to execute safely
signal_quality_notes: Extremely short-term. Avoid holding overnight.
Spread wide is the main hazard. Do not enter if spread > 10 bps.
template_families.expected_trade_shape: Burst of ticks and rapid price movements
false_positive_patterns: Isolated block trade causing transient volatility spike
EndOfDay execution re-balancing wicks
exit_hints: Time stop of 3 bars
Exit if spread expands significantly

template_families.description: Detect volatility regime shift from high to low — setup for squeeze

thesis_template.what_edge_it_targets: Volatility regime transitioning from expansion to contraction — anticipating next squeeze breakout
thesis_template.entry_logic: volatility_ratio_5_20 < 0.7 AND BollingerWidth declining over 3 bars
thesis_template.failure_mode: Volatility stays low indefinitely — no breakout follows
thesis_template.hold_duration_bars: N/A — this is a setup detector, not a trade entry

confirmation_logic_guidelines: Check that spreads are extremely tight (liquidity returning)
Verify volume drops to a minimum
invalidation_logic_guidelines: Invalidate if a sudden volatility expansion occurs prematurely
Invalidate if price breaks the range edges before squeeze completes
signal_quality_notes: This is a monitoring signal. Never convert directly to trades.
Squeeze can last for hours.
template_families.expected_trade_shape: Sideways range contraction with low candles and tight spreads
false_positive_patterns: Temporary drop in activity during holiday hours
Range-bound creep with wide spreads
exit_hints: N/A - signal only

template_families.description: Detect state shifts before bar-confirmed regime flip

thesis_template.what_edge_it_targets: Early state change signal before conventional indicators confirm regime flip
thesis_template.entry_logic: tick_ret_5 directional AND trade_flow_imbalance_20 aligned AND live_ret accelerating
thesis_template.failure_mode: Whipsaw around transition zone — intrabar signals reverse before bar closes
thesis_template.ideal_regime: transition_ambiguous — bet on regime direction before it's confirmed

confirmation_logic_guidelines: BTC should confirm the same directional move (beta support)
Relative volume should expand
invalidation_logic_guidelines: Invalidate if flow imbalance collapses to neutral
Invalidate if price reverses back into old regime levels
signal_quality_notes: High risk of whipsaw. Use very tight validation parameters.
Do not hold past the bar close if trend does not materialize.
template_families.expected_trade_shape: Explosion of buying or selling that flips the regime
false_positive_patterns: Brief spoofing spikes on orderbook with no actual transaction depth
Liquidation wicks that get absorbed instantly
exit_hints: Exit if the target regime is not established within 2 bars
Exit on reverse flow signals

template_families.description: Price-momentum divergence: price and MACD/RSI moving in opposite directions

thesis_template.what_edge_it_targets: Trend losing momentum before price reversal — early reversal warning
thesis_template.entry_logic: Price making higher high but MACD_hist making lower high (bearish divergence) = short entry
thesis_template.failure_mode: Divergence can persist many bars before resolving — requires patience and tight stops
thesis_template.ideal_regime: Late stage uptrend or downtrend with decreasing MACD_hist

confirmation_logic_guidelines: Confirm that flow imbalance starts to align with divergence direction
Verify volume drops on the final price peak (exhaustion)
invalidation_logic_guidelines: Invalidate if price breaks above the divergence peak by more than 0.5%
Invalidate if MACD histogram makes a fresh peak in the trend direction
signal_quality_notes: Divergence needs time to play out. Patience is key.
Look for multiple divergences (double or triple) to improve win-rate.
template_families.expected_trade_shape: Slow round-topping pattern followed by sharp collapse/bounce
false_positive_patterns: Strong momentum trends resetting MACD over multiple wicks
Sideways consolidation where indicators reset without price movement
exit_hints: Exit if momentum turns back in trend direction
Time stop of 15 bars

template_families.description: Entry on sustained order flow imbalance — aggressive buying or selling detected

thesis_template.what_edge_it_targets: Persistent directional order flow precedes price moves — follow smart money
thesis_template.entry_logic: trade_flow_imbalance_20 > 0.4 (strong buy imbalance) AND trade_flow_imbalance_50 > 0.2 (confirmed sustained) AND large_trade_ratio > 0.15 (institutional size present)
thesis_template.failure_mode: Spoofing or short-term imbalance that reverses quickly
thesis_template.ideal_regime: uptrend or transition with accelerating flow

confirmation_logic_guidelines: Confirm that relative volume is expanding
Verify that price is drifting in the direction of the flow
invalidation_logic_guidelines: Invalidate if flow imbalance collapses below neutral within 10 trades
Invalidate if spread expands and halts executions
signal_quality_notes: Highly reactive. Keep execution slippage tight.
Institutional block trades are positive but avoid retail clustering.
template_families.expected_trade_shape: Swift price rise/fall with heavy tape activity
false_positive_patterns: Rebalancing trades by market makers
Arbitrage bots execution loops
exit_hints: Exit when tape slows down
Exit if large trade ratio drops to zero

template_families.description: Exploit BTC-driven beta moves on correlated assets

thesis_template.what_edge_it_targets: When BTC makes a strong move, highly correlated assets follow with slight lag
thesis_template.entry_logic: btc_ret_1 > 0.003 (BTC strong up bar) AND market_correlation_20 > 0.7 (target is BTC-correlated) AND target ema_spread_8_21 > 0 (trend aligned)
thesis_template.failure_mode: Decorrelation event — asset diverges from BTC due to idiosyncratic news
thesis_template.ideal_regime: uptrend or downtrend with high correlation to BTC

confirmation_logic_guidelines: Confirm that flow imbalance on target asset aligns with BTC direction
Verify target asset's relative volume expands
invalidation_logic_guidelines: Invalidate if target asset moves opposite to BTC (decorrelation)
Invalidate if BTC's move collapses or reverses
signal_quality_notes: Only trade when correlation is established. Watch news feeds.
Look for lagging assets with cleanest setups.
template_families.expected_trade_shape: Delayed matching impulse bar on the target asset
false_positive_patterns: BTC moves on spot ETF inflows that do not impact Altcoins
Altcoin-specific negative news overriding BTC correlation
exit_hints: Exit when BTC impulse completes
Exit if correlation drops below 0.5

template_families.description: Hyperliquid perpetual funding rate extremes — contrarian fade or confirmation

thesis_template.what_edge_it_targets: Funding rate extremes force crowded side to unwind — mechanical reversion
thesis_template.entry_logic: Funding > threshold means longs overpaying → fade long / enter short
thesis_template.failure_mode: Trend so strong funding stays extreme for extended period
thesis_template.ideal_regime: Any regime — funding is regime-independent signal

template_families.description: Forced liquidation cascade detection — snap-back after overshoot

thesis_template.what_edge_it_targets: Liquidation cascades overshoot fair value — snap-back within 2-5 bars
thesis_template.entry_logic: ATR spike + volume surge + RSI extreme = liquidation event signature
thesis_template.failure_mode: Structural panic (not liquidation) — price continues one direction

template_families.description: VWAP as institutional price anchor — deviation reversion

thesis_template.what_edge_it_targets: Institutional algos use VWAP anchors — deviation creates mechanical pull-back
thesis_template.entry_logic: Price deviation > threshold from VWAP with volume confirmation
thesis_template.failure_mode: Strong momentum ignores VWAP — trending away

template_families.description: High volatility momentum burst — ride dominant force during vol expansion

thesis_template.what_edge_it_targets: Volatility expansion with dominant flow — momentum continues short-term
thesis_template.entry_logic: ATR above threshold + flow strongly one-sided = ride the burst
thesis_template.failure_mode: Exhaustion wick immediately reversing the move

signal_catalog.description: Band squeeze followed by directional breakout with volume confirmation
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Exploit volatility contraction followed by volume-confirmed directional breakout
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: Bollinger Bands width contracts below 15%, expecting imminent breakout
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Breakout is confirmed when relative volume is above 1.2 and tape aligns
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Breakout fails if bands expand too wide without trend or spread widens
signal_catalog.execution_sensitivity_summary: Highly sensitive to bid-ask spread and execution latency

signal_catalog.description: Z-score extreme displacement with reversion expectation
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Trade extreme statistical overextensions expecting quick mean reversion
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: Z-Score close reaches +/- 1.5, showing significant price displacement
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Reversion is confirmed when RSI reaches extreme bounds (30/70)
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Thesis fails if Z-score continues to expand beyond 3.0 or trend develops
signal_catalog.execution_sensitivity_summary: Moderate sensitivity to micro-volatility and order flow imbalances

signal_catalog.description: MACD above signal line with positive histogram — trend momentum aligned
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Ride persistent trend momentum confirmed by MACD and EMA alignment
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: MACD line crosses above signal line with positive medium trend bias
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Continuation is confirmed by positive histogram and average volume support
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Trend is invalidated if MACD crosses back or price falls below 20 SMA
signal_catalog.execution_sensitivity_summary: Low sensitivity to short-term spread, relies on structural trend follow

signal_catalog.description: Price at Bollinger extreme confirmed by RSI and flow exhaustion
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Counter-trend entry when price touches band edge with RSI exhaustion
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: Price reaches Bollinger Band extremes (close to lower/upper band)
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Confirmed when RSI joins the overextended zone indicating exhaustion
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Invalidated if selling/buying pressure expands or volatility surges
signal_catalog.execution_sensitivity_summary: High sensitivity to order tape and spread width at band edge

signal_catalog.description: Pullback to SMA20 in established trend — re-entry signal
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Re-enter the primary trend after a shallow pullback to the 20 SMA
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: Price retraces close to 20 SMA while long-term trend remains intact
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Pullback confirmed if RSI bounces from mid-zone with average volume
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Invalidated if price breaks significantly below 20 SMA or trend flips
signal_catalog.execution_sensitivity_summary: Low sensitivity to execution delay, requires structural level hold

signal_catalog.description: RSI(14) extreme with bounce confirmation from flow
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Trade oversold bounces in range-bound or early trend conditions
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: RSI(14) drops below 30, showing oversold conditions
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Bounce confirmed when trade flow imbalance turns positive
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Invalidated if RSI drops into extreme capitulation (<20) or structure breaks
signal_catalog.execution_sensitivity_summary: Moderate sensitivity to execution slippage and trade size

signal_catalog.description: RSI(14) overbought with fade confirmation
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Fade overbought price levels in range-bound or late trend conditions
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: RSI(14) climbs above 70, showing overbought conditions
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Fade confirmed when trade flow imbalance turns negative
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Invalidated if RSI climbs above 80 (parabolic expansion) or trend persists
signal_catalog.execution_sensitivity_summary: Moderate sensitivity to liquidation wicks and spread spikes

signal_catalog.description: MACD histogram sign change — momentum flip signal
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Identify momentum exhaustion via divergence before price trend reverses
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: Price-momentum divergence occurs between close and MACD histogram
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Reversal confirmed if RSI joins the overextended zone
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Invalidated if price trend resumes with new peak or slope collapses
signal_catalog.execution_sensitivity_summary: Low sensitivity to latency, requires swing point validation

signal_catalog.description: Volume surge > 2x average with directional bar — smart money entry
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Trade high-participation breakouts backed by institutional size volume
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: Bollinger squeeze occurs, expecting large directional expansion
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Confirmed when relative volume surges above 2x and large trades are present
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Invalidated if volume drops below average or bid/ask spread expands
signal_catalog.execution_sensitivity_summary: High sensitivity to execution slips and liquidity depth at boundary

signal_catalog.description: Sustained buy/sell flow imbalance with large trade participation
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Follow aggressive market buying/selling tape flow imbalances
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: Short-term order flow imbalance exceeds +/- 0.1 threshold
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Sustained flow confirmed by 50-trade flow imbalance exceeding +/- 0.2
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Invalidated if large trades disappear or execution costs expand
signal_catalog.execution_sensitivity_summary: Extremely high sensitivity to tape delay and exchange execution limits

signal_catalog.description: Volatility contraction setup — not a trade, but flags upcoming breakout candidate
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Monitor extreme volatility compression for breakout preparation
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: Volatility ratio 5/20 drops below 0.7, indicating compression
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Setup confirmed if Bollinger Width contracts below 15%
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Invalidated if volatility expands prematurely above 1.2
signal_catalog.execution_sensitivity_summary: Low sensitivity, monitor-only signal with no execution candidate

signal_catalog.description: Intrabar tick/flow pattern suggesting imminent regime change
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Anticipate regime shifts via leading intrabar flow and tick returns
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: Directional tick return drift detected over last 5 ticks
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Shift confirmed by positive/negative order flow imbalances
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Thesis fails if price drift halts or spreads widen excessively
signal_catalog.execution_sensitivity_summary: High sensitivity to execution queue and tick feed latency

signal_catalog.description: Stochastic %K below 20 with %D cross — classic oversold bounce
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Trade short-term oversold bounces using stochastic and RSI confluence
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: Stochastic %K oscillator drops below 20, indicating oversold state
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Bounce confirmed when RSI matches oversold and buying tape starts
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Thesis fails if stochastic drops to absolute bottom or support fails
signal_catalog.execution_sensitivity_summary: Moderate sensitivity to trade execution queue delays

signal_catalog.description: Williams %R at extreme (-95 to -100 for oversold, 0 to -5 for overbought)
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Mean reversion entry on extreme price displacements via Williams %R
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: Williams %R crosses -80 (oversold) or -20 (overbought) boundary
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Reversion confirmed when RSI aligns with the overextended conditions
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Invalidated if Williams %R stays stuck at absolute boundaries (extreme trend)
signal_catalog.execution_sensitivity_summary: Moderate sensitivity to stop run wicks and order slips

signal_catalog.description: Strong rejection candle (pin bar) at key level — reversal signal
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Trade structural price reversals confirmed by pin bar wick wicks
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: Pin bar ratio is greater than 3.0, showing a strong wick rejection tail
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Confirmed if breakout occurs with average or expanding volume support
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Invalidated if price breaches the opposite side of the pin bar range
signal_catalog.execution_sensitivity_summary: Moderate sensitivity, execution near the wick midpoint is ideal

signal_catalog.description: Inside bar compression followed by breakout of parent bar range
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Capture expansion break following temporary range compression inside parent bar
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: Inside bar indicator is triggered, showing compression pattern
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Confirmed if breakout bar volume exceeds average
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Thesis fails if price collapses back inside parent range or width expands
signal_catalog.execution_sensitivity_summary: Moderate sensitivity to boundary stop slippages

signal_catalog.description: 4-5 consecutive directional bars — exhaustion reversion setup
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Counter-trend trade expecting exhaustion after consecutive bars
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: Price builds 4 or more consecutive up/down bars, indicating overstretch
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Exhaustion confirmed when RSI reaches extreme bounds (30/70)
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Invalidated if price goes parabolic (6 or more bars) showing strong continuation

signal_catalog.description: ETH or SOL lagging BTC strong move — catch-up trade
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Exploit delayed altcoin reaction to violent BTC price impulses
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: BTC executes a strong price impulse exceeding 0.3% in one bar
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Confirmed if the asset maintains high correlation with BTC (>0.7)
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Invalidated if the correlation breaks down or BTC move reverses
signal_catalog.execution_sensitivity_summary: Moderate sensitivity to altcoin lag latency

signal_catalog.description: Funding rate at extreme — contrarian fade as squeezed side forced to close
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Extreme positive funding means longs are paying too much — expect short squeeze unwind. Extreme negative = opposite.
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: Funding rate exceeds ±0.08% per hour, indicating crowded one-sided positioning
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: RSI confirms overbought/oversold condition aligning with funding extreme
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Funding going parabolic suggests trend continuation, not reversion

signal_catalog.description: Open interest rising while price falling — short accumulation precedes short squeeze
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Rising OI during price decline = new shorts entering. When price stops falling, shorts are trapped → violent squeeze up.
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: OI increases >0.5% per bar while price is below SMA20
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: RSI not yet oversold (still has room), flow not heavily negative
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: OI starts declining (shorts covering = move over) or price breaks further

signal_catalog.description: Open interest rising while price rising — long accumulation precedes long liquidation cascade
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Rising OI during price rise = new longs entering near highs. Any reversal triggers cascade liquidation down.
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: OI increases >0.5% per bar while price is above SMA20
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: RSI not yet overbought, flow starting to weaken
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: OI drops (longs exiting cleanly) or price continues parabolic

signal_catalog.description: Post-liquidation cascade overshoot — price snaps back after forced liquidations clear
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Liquidation cascades create extreme intrabar overshoots. Once the forced selling/buying exhausts, price snaps back 30-60% of the move within 2-5 bars.
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: ATR spikes above 1.2% per bar AND volume above 2x average — liquidation event signature
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: RSI reaches extreme (<25 or >75) confirming overshoot
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: ATR too extreme (>4%) = structural panic, not liquidation snap — avoid

signal_catalog.description: Perpetual futures mark price premium/discount to index — statistical reversion trade
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: Perp mark price deviates from index due to order flow imbalance. Funding rate mechanism forces reversion — arbitrageurs close the gap.
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: Mark vs index spread exceeds 15 bps — statistically significant overshoot
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Funding rate confirms one-sided pressure building
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Spread goes parabolic (>50 bps) = structural dislocation, not simple reversion

signal_catalog.description: Price significantly deviating from VWAP — institutional reversion pressure
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: VWAP acts as institutional anchor. Large algos run VWAP execution orders — deviation beyond 0.6% creates statistical pull-back pressure.
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: Price deviates more than 0.6% from VWAP — typical reversal zone
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Volume present and RSI displaced from neutral confirming momentum
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Deviation going parabolic (>2.5%) = strong breakout, VWAP reversion fails

signal_catalog.description: High volatility momentum burst — ride the dominant force during volatility expansion
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: When volatility expands and one side dominates flow, the move has momentum. Don't fade high_volatility — ride it for 3-8 bars then exit.
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: ATR above 0.8% per bar with volatility expansion — momentum event confirmed
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Flow strongly one-sided (>0.25) with elevated volume
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: ATR too extreme or flow collapses = exhaustion

signal_catalog.description: RSI fractal divergence — price and RSI making opposite fractal highs/lows
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: RSI fractal divergence (higher low while price lower low, or vice versa) is one of the highest probability reversal signals in technical analysis.
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: RSI divergence score exceeds 0.15 magnitude from fractal analysis
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: RSI displaced from neutral and MACD histogram present
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Divergence collapses (fractal invalidated) or execution cost too high

signal_catalog.description: Session range extreme rejection — fade price at statistical range boundaries
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: In range_chop regime, price consistently returns from extremes. BB outer bands + Williams %R confluencing at highs/lows is highest win-rate setup.
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: Price reaches top 10% or bottom 10% of Bollinger range
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Williams %R confirms extreme AND flow is not strongly directional
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Strong directional flow or bands expanding = breakout incoming, not reversion

signal_catalog.description: Micro-momentum scalp on tick return acceleration with flow confirmation
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: When tick returns accelerate beyond 0.1% and large trades confirm direction, price continues for 1-3 more bars. Very high frequency, very short hold.
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: Tick return over last 5 ticks exceeds 0.1% with large trade presence
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: Flow imbalance >0.2 confirms institutional participation
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: Micro volatility too high (noise) or spread too wide

signal_catalog.description: EMA 8/21 crossover with volume expansion — clean trend initiation signal
signal_catalog.thesis_summary: EMA8/21 spread widening above noise floor (0.08%) with volume signals clean trend initiation — most reliable trend entry on 1m perp.
signal_catalog.entry_logic_summary: EMA 8/21 spread exceeds noise threshold with average volume
signal_catalog.confirmation_summary: RSI in trend zone (45-70) and MACD histogram positive
signal_catalog.invalidation_summary: EMA spread collapses back or volume dries up
